enriched_description: Large eared seal measuring 1.8-2.5 meters in length with streamlined fusiform body. Fur is short and coarse, ranging from brown to dark grey, lighter on ventral surface. Most distinctive feature is external ear pinnae (visible ear flaps) distinguishing from true seals. Foreflippers are large, broad, and hairless on underside, used for terrestrial locomotion by rotating under body. Hind flippers can rotate forward for walking on land. Head is broad with prominent sagittal crest in males. Males develop thick neck mane and are significantly larger than females (sexual dimorphism). Whiskers (vibrissae) are prominent and sensitive. Body exhibits bilateral symmetry. Weight ranges 200-1000 kg depending on species and sex.

Tiny toy dog breed measuring 15-23 cm at shoulder and weighing 1-3 kg. Head is distinctive apple-domed (rounded skull) with prominent protruding eyes and large erect ears set wide apart. Muzzle is short and pointed. Coat varieties include smooth (short, glossy, close-lying) and long (soft, fine, slightly wavy with feathering on ears, legs, and tail). Coloration ranges from solid fawn, black, white, chocolate, cream to parti-color and merle patterns. Body is compact and slightly longer than tall with level topline. Tail is moderately long, carried in sickle curve over back. Legs are slender and straight. Expression is alert and terrier-like.

Small toy dog breed measuring 20-27 cm at shoulder and weighing 2-4 kg. Head is broad and domed with large round dark eyes set wide apart, creating distinctive astonished expression. Muzzle is very short and broad. Ears are small, triangular, heavily feathered, and set wide on head. Coat is long, silky, straight, and profuse, lying flat against body. Coloration is either black-and-white or red-and-white with distinctive markings: white body with colored patches on head, ears, and base of tail. White blaze runs up face between eyes. Body is square and compact with level topline. Tail is heavily plumed and carried curled over back. Legs are feathered and fine-boned. Gait is stylish and animated.

Small toy dog breed measuring 20-25 cm at shoulder and weighing 2-3.5 kg. Most distinctive feature is long, straight, silky white coat that hangs to the ground when untrimmed, lacking undercoat. Hair texture is fine and glossy, resembling human hair. Head is slightly rounded with moderate stop. Eyes are large, round, and dark brown with black eye rims. Nose is jet black. Ears are drop ears, heavily feathered, hanging close to head. Body is compact and balanced with level topline. Tail is plumed and carried curved over back. Legs are straight and fine-boned with black paw pads. Entire coat should be pure white; light tan or lemon on ears is permissible. Gait is smooth and flowing.

Small toy dog breed measuring 15-23 cm at shoulder and weighing 3-6 kg. Most distinctive feature is broad flat muzzle and wrinkled face creating lion-like expression. Head is massive and broad with flat skull. Eyes are large, round, dark, and prominent. Nose is black and broad with wide nostrils. Ears are heart-shaped, heavily feathered, and carried close to head. Coat is long, straight, and profuse with coarse outer coat and soft undercoat, forming mane around neck and shoulders. Coloration includes all colors: gold, red, black, white, cream, parti-color. Body is compact, heavy for size, with thick chest and rolled gait. Tail is heavily plumed and carried curved over back. Legs are short, thick, and bowed. Weight should not exceed 6.4 kg.

Small toy dog breed measuring 23-28 cm at shoulder and weighing 4-7.5 kg. Head is broad and round with short square muzzle and undershot bite. Eyes are large, round, dark, and widely spaced creating warm expression. Ears are large, drop, heavily feathered, and blend into neck coat. Coat is long, dense, flowing, and double-layered with profuse undercoat. Hair falls straight down both sides of body, parting along spine. Coloration is variable: gold, white, black, liver, brindle, or parti-color with white blaze on forehead and white tail tip preferred. Body is compact and sturdy with level topline. Tail is heavily plumed and carried curled over back in chrysanthemum pattern. Legs are short and sturdy. Gait is smooth and arrogant.

Small toy spaniel breed measuring 25-31 cm at shoulder and weighing 3.5-6.5 kg. Most distinctive feature is rich red-and-white parti-color coat with clearly defined red patches on white ground. Head is domed with short upturned nose and well-defined stop. Eyes are large, round, dark, and set wide apart creating gentle expression. Ears are long, set low, and heavily feathered with long fringe. Muzzle is short and square. Body is compact and cobby with short back and level topline. Coat is long, silky, and straight with moderate feathering on ears, chest, legs, and tail. Tail is docked and carried level with back, well-feathered. Legs are straight with fine bone and feathered hindquarters. Gait is free and active.

Small slender toy spaniel measuring 20-28 cm at shoulder and weighing 2-5 kg. Most distinctive feature is large erect butterfly-like ears (papillon = butterfly in French) with long fringing hair. Ears are set laterally on head, wide at base with rounded tips. Head is small and slightly rounded with fine muzzle and definite stop. Eyes are dark, round, and alert. Body is fine-boned, elegant, and slightly longer than tall with level topline. Coat is long, silky, straight, and abundant, lying flat on body. Coloration is white with patches of any color except liver: black, red, sable, lemon. White blaze on face and white collar preferred. Tail is long, plumed, and arched over back. Legs are fine and straight. Gait is quick, graceful, and effortless.

Very small active terrier breed measuring 15-25 cm at shoulder and weighing 1.5-3.5 kg. Body is compact, well-proportioned, and slightly longer than tall with level topline. Head is elongated and flat with small V-shaped ears that may be erect or semi-erect. Eyes are small, dark, and alert with keen expression. Muzzle is moderately long and pointed. Coat is short, smooth, glossy, and close-lying. Coloration is typically black-and-tan with rich mahogany markings on muzzle, chest, legs, and ventral surface. Some varieties display blue-and-tan. Tail is set high and carried gaily. Legs are straight and fine-boned but muscular. Body exhibits terrier characteristics in miniature: bold, alert, and energetic demeanor. Gait is free and active with good reach.

Large powerful hunting dog measuring 61-69 cm at shoulder and weighing 30-40 kg. Most distinctive feature is ridge of reversed hair growing forward along spine from shoulders to hips, forming two symmetrical crowns (whorls). Ridge is clearly defined and approximately 5 cm wide. Coat is short, dense, sleek, and glossy, ranging from light wheaten to red wheaten coloration. Head is fairly long and flat with moderate stop. Eyes are round, bright, and intelligent, color matching coat. Ears are set high, medium-sized, and carried close to head. Muzzle is long and powerful. Body is muscular and athletic with deep chest and level topline. Tail is thick at base, tapering, and carried in slight curve. Legs are straight and muscular. Gait is free and powerful with strong drive.
